title: Hearty Smoky Slovakian Bass En-croute
description: A smoky, molten Slovakian dish featuring sea bass fillets wrapped in puff pastry, perfect for a quick and satisfying weeknight dinner.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place the sea bass fillets on a flat surface and season with salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika.
Roll out the puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Place the pastry on top of the sea bass fillets, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with olive oil and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake for 15 minutes or until the pastry is golden brown.
While the pastry is baking, melt the butter and mix with garlic and lemon juice in a small saucepan.
Remove the pastry from the oven and brush the garlic-lemon butter mixture on top.
Return the pastry to the oven and bake for an additional 5-7 minutes or until the butter is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with parsley and feta cheese.
